company_profiles.title: Company Profile & Business Information
company_profiles.description: Stores organization configuration, legal name, tax identification, contact details, default currency, and sync settings.

phone.description: Business telephone or mobile support line

currency.description: Standard business currency (e.g. KES, USD, EUR, GBP, NGN, ZAR)

paymentOptions.description: Payment remittance options (Bank, M-PESA/Mobile Money, instructions)

products_services.title: Products & Services Catalog
products_services.description: Catalog of offered products and services with standardized unit prices and measurement units.

unitType.description: Measurement unit: units, kg, g, pcs, bags, boxes, liters, hours, service, meters

sku.description: Stock Keeping Unit or item reference code

isActive.description: Whether item is currently active for sales

transactions.title: Financial Transactions
transactions.description: Ledger entries including sales, expenses, cash inflows and disbursements.

paymentMethod.description: Payment channel: mobile_money, bank_transfer, card, cash, online

referenceNo.description: Invoice number or transaction reference code

productId.description: Optional linked product or service ID

quantity.description: Purchased quantity / number of units or kgs

expense_categories.title: Expense Categories & Accounts
expense_categories.description: Business expense accounts and categories used to classify and track company expenditures.

group.description: Departmental grouping (e.g. Staff & Welfare, Utilities, Taxes, etc.)

taxDeductible.description: Whether this expense is tax deductible

isActive.description: Whether this category is currently active for selection

billing_documents.title: Quotations, Invoices and Receipts
billing_documents.description: Commercial billing documents including proforma quotations, payment invoices, and official payment receipts for items and services.

type.description: Document type: quotation, invoice, or receipt

documentNumber.description: Unique serialized identifier (e.g. QT-2026-001, INV-2026-001, REC-2026-001)

dueDate.description: Payment due date or quotation validity date (YYYY-MM-DD)

items.description: List of line items with quantity, rate, unit, and item details

subtotal.description: Sum of all line items before tax and discount

paymentMethod.description: Payment method used (for receipts or payments)

paymentReference.description: Payment reference code or transaction receipt code

status.description: Workflow status: draft, sent, accepted, paid, partially_paid, etc.

trash_bundles.title: Trash Bin & Cascaded Deleted Items
trash_bundles.description: Stores deleted quotations, invoices, receipts, and their linked ledger transactions for safekeeping and one-click restoration.

primaryItemType.description: Type of primary deleted item (quotation, invoice, receipt, transaction)

primaryItemTitle.description: Display title of the primary item

primaryItemNumber.description: Document number or reference of primary item

trashedAt.description: ISO timestamp when item was moved to trash

documents.description: All deleted billing documents in this cascade bundle

transactions.description: All cascaded ledger transactions in this bundle

description.description: Summary explanation of the deleted bundle

users.title: System Users & Staff Profiles
users.description: Registered operators, staff, and administrators with role-based access control and contact details.

displayName.description: Full name of staff member or administrator

role.description: System role: super_admin, admin, staff, or user

disabledReason.description: Reason for account suspension or login disablement (e.g. license_expired, suspended, custom)

disabledMessage.description: Custom error message or license expiration notice displayed to user when login is disabled

isActive.description: Whether the user account is active

password.description: Hashed authentication password or credential for email login

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

customers.title: Customer Directory
customers.description: Stores client records, contact numbers, email, physical delivery address, tax identification (KRA PIN), notes, and historical spending.

address.description: Physical business address / office delivery location

notes.description: Internal customer remarks or payment terms

system_license.title: System License Configuration & Countdown
system_license.description: Stores organization activation date, computed 1-year expiry, activation author, and licensing state.

activationDate.description: System activation date YYYY-MM-DD set by Super Administrator

activatedBy.description: Super administrator name or email who activated the license

activatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when license was activated

/company_profiles/{docId}.description: Company profile details, currency, tax pin, and business information

/products_services/{itemId}.description: Catalog of products and services with pricing and unit metrics

/expense_categories/{categoryId}.description: Configured business expense categories and accounts

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Sales and expense ledger transaction records

/billing_documents/{documentId}.description: Commercial quotations, tax invoices, and payment receipts

/trash_bundles/{trashId}.description: Trash bin storage for deleted quotations, invoices, receipts, and ledger items

/users/{userId}.description: System user profiles, roles (admin/staff), and credentials

/customers/{customerId}.description: Client database directory with name, contact, KRA PIN, and address

/system_license/{licenseId}.description: System license activation date, 1-year computed expiration, and countdown metrics
